services.desc: In recent years, short-term rental platforms such as Airbnb have become a major addition to the tourism sector in this region. This has allowed tourists to have a variety of experiences within the County, including access to areas previously visited and unvisited. As of June 13, 2023, Clearwater County approved a new Short-Term Rental Bylaw 1139/23 (click here to learn more) which puts measures in place to mitigate negative impacts on the surrounding community such as license requirements, application forms, enforcement procedures, and penalties. blurb: The Nordegg Discovery CentreOnce a schoolhouse that educated generations of Nordegg children, this historic building now lives on as the Nordegg Discovery Centre (NDC). Today, it serves as the starting point for Brazeau Collieries Mine Site Tours and a welcoming hub to explore Nordegg’s rich mining and community history.
